_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec. TSK_WDCL_* not in context_prefixes_in_use — no collision. Combined prime+paint spec (primer conditional on substrate_state). Domain: interior, context: NC. SF-based wood ceiling panel/board measurement. ceiling_style (flat_plank/beadboard/tongue_and_groove/coffered) is a configuration dimension driving complexity modifier. Height varies (PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND applies) — ALL work is overhead. Overhead penalty baked into base rates.

paintable_items.name: Wood ceiling panel/board surface
paintable_items.notes: Single SF item for entire wood ceiling surface. For board styles (flat_plank, beadboard, T&G), includes board faces and joint detail. For coffered style, includes panel faces AND beam faces within the ceiling system. Measured as total ceiling area covered by wood surface. Internal complexity captured by ceiling_style modifier.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_WDCL_* not in context_prefixes_in_use. Checked against all existing prefixes: FLOOR_PROTECT, DUST_WIPE, LIGHT_SAND, EDGE_SEAL, SPOT_FILL, CAULK, PRIME_*, FINISH_*, INTERSTAGE_SAND, FINAL_INSPECT, FRAME_*, DOOR_*, CEIL_*, WALL_*, TRIM_*, WIN_*, STRS_*, WNSC_*, WDWL_*.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_WDCL_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based (FLOOR_PROTECT_FULL, FLOOR_PROTECT_PERIM, WALL_MASK, FIXTURE_MASK, OPENING_COVER, DUST_CLEAN, SAND_PREP, FILL_FASTENERS, CAULK_JOINTS, CAULK_PERIMETER, SEAL_MDF_EDGES, PRIME_FACES, FINISH_SPRAY, FINISH_BRUSH, SAND_BETWEEN, INSPECT_COAT, FINAL_INSPECT, REMOVE_PROTECTION, REMOVE_WALL_MASK, VACUUM)

expected_modules.description: Floor protection (full for spray, perimeter for brush), wall upper band masking (spray only), fixture masking (always), opening covers (spray only), staging.
Dust wipe, sand per substrate/QT, fill fastener holes, caulk board/panel joints, caulk perimeter (ceiling-to-wall junction), MDF edge seal (bare MDF only).
Primer coat — conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE. Primer type driven by substrate (MDF two-step, FJP stain-block, softwood standard, hardwood tannin-block). ALL primer work is overhead.
Finish coat application. Spray: sweep passes following board direction (board styles) or field-then-beam (coffered). Brush: systematic overhead section-by-section. ALL work is overhead.
Between-coat inspect, sand, repair — universal at ALL quality tiers. Overhead sanding is especially fatiguing. Rigid block sanding per FFD §15.4.1.
Final quality check. Visual inspection from below with angled light. Check board groove holidays (beadboard/T&G) and beam-panel junction holidays (coffered).
Protection teardown (floor, wall mask, fixture covers, opening covers), floor vacuum, tool cleaning.

module_prefix.notes: Combined prime+paint spec. Prime module conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE. No internal component sequencing needed — single SF item. Height varies per room — estimation engine applies height modifier via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND. ALL work is overhead — base rates already reflect overhead penalty.

paintscope_keys.description: Total SF of wood ceiling surface. For board styles, includes board faces and joint detail. For coffered, includes panel faces AND beam faces. Measured as total ceiling area covered by wood surface.
paintscope_keys.notes: Primary input for this spec. No existing key covers wood ceiling surfaces. PS_SURFACE_SF.CEILING_FIELD is for drywall ceilings. Semantically distinct — wood substrate, fine finish doctrine, overhead methodology.

paintscope_keys.description: Full floor protection area below ceiling work zone (spray application). Overspray from overhead falls onto entire floor.
Perimeter floor protection area at ceiling work zone (brush application). Drop cloth runners along work path.
Upper wall band masking SF near ceiling-wall junction for overspray containment. Paper/plastic film extending 12-24 inches down wall.
paintscope_keys.notes: Conditional on application_method = spray. Exists in PaintScope Quantity Key Catalog (Area Protection Keys Non-Floor section) but not in id_registry PS_ entries_in_active_use. Needs activation. Inverse of PS_PROTECT_LF.CEILING_LINE used by SF_WOOD_WALL_NC.

paintscope_keys.description: Ceiling-mounted fixture count for masking (lights, fans, smoke detectors, sprinkler heads).
paintscope_keys.notes: Always required — fixtures are embedded in the ceiling work surface.

paintscope_keys.description: Height classification for modifier selection. Values: STD (8-9 ft), STEP (9-12 ft), EXT (13-17 ft), SCAFFOLD (18-24 ft), LIFT (25+ ft).
paintscope_keys.notes: Activated by SF_WOOD_WALL_NC. ALL ceiling work requires overhead positioning — height modifier applies on top of overhead base rates.

quality_tier.notes: QT2 not applicable — wood ceilings are prominent millwork per Millwork Doctrine §6.

application_method.notes: Spray preferred for overhead — faster, more ergonomic for horizontal overhead surfaces. Brush for occupied spaces, small areas, or detail work. No backroll method — overhead wood surfaces do not require backrolling.

ceiling_style.notes: Spec-specific configuration dimension (not in controlled_enums.json). Drives production rate complexity modifier: flat_plank=1.0x, beadboard=1.15x, tongue_and_groove=1.10x, coffered=1.35x. Per Millwork Doctrine §7.2 adapted for ceiling.

sheen.notes: Sheen/QT gate: satin at QT3+, semi-gloss at QT4+, gloss at QT5 only. Satin default for softer appearance and reduced glare from ceiling-mounted lighting.

substrate_state.notes: SS_BARE requires primer (substrate-driven chemistry). SS_PRIMED_FACTORY skips primer. Standard NC delivery is factory-primed.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF for wood ceiling panel tasks. EA_ROOM for room-level setup/cleanup. EA for fixture masking. FIXED for tool cleanup.

product_role.notes: Combined prime+paint spec. Sealer for MDF edge sealing (solvent-based).

protection_level.notes: full_cover for floor_full (spray), edge_only for floor_perimeter (brush), partial_cover for wall_upper_band (spray), full_cover for fixture_covers, light_mask for opening_cover_lightweight (spray).

surface_texture.notes: Wood ceiling panel/board surfaces are smooth.

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline, QT4/QT5=selective_multiplier on qt_scaled tasks, QT5 brush=additional_rounds.

surface_ids.notes: ceiling_panel is proposed as new surface_id for wood ceiling substrate — distinct from ceiling_field (drywall ceiling). Follows pattern: wall_panel (wood wall) vs wall_field (drywall wall), wainscot_panel (wainscot) vs wall_field (drywall wall). Adjacent surfaces: wall_field (drywall wall below), trim_crown (crown molding at junction), wall_panel (wood wall below in paneled rooms), ceiling_field (adjacent drywall ceiling at transitions).

zone_ids.notes: Full floor coverage for overhead spray overspray. Entire room floor below ceiling work zone.
Perimeter drop cloth runners for brush drip protection.

Upper wall band masking near ceiling for spray overspray containment. Paper/plastic film at ceiling-wall junction extending 12-24 inches down wall. Zone exists in Protection_Zones_Reference.md (Surface-Adjacent Protection Zones table) but not in id_registry zone_ids entries_in_active_use. Needs activation. Inverse of ceiling_line zone used by SF_WOOD_WALL_NC.
Ceiling-mounted fixtures (lights, fans, smoke detectors) — embedded in the work surface. Always required regardless of application method.
Lightweight plastic pin-up over window/door openings for overhead spray overspray fallout. Spray only.

primer_systems.name: Solvent-based MDF edge sealer
primer_systems.notes: Reuse. Step 1 of two-step MDF prime.

primer_systems.name: High-build latex face primer for MDF
primer_systems.notes: Reuse. Step 2 of two-step MDF prime.

material_system_prefix.notes: All material systems reuse existing IDs. 3 finish systems (SYS_FF_*) + 5 primer systems (SYS_PRIMER_*). No new system IDs needed. Identical material chemistry matrix to SF_WOOD_WALL_NC and SF_WAINSCOT_PANEL_NC.

consumable_prefix.notes: All consumables reuse existing CON_ IDs. No new consumable IDs needed. Floor protection for spray requires more material than wood wall (full room vs perimeter). CON_SANDING_SPONGE_FINE for beadboard/T&G groove and coffered beam-panel inside corner sanding.

proposed_for_this_spec.description: Wood ceiling panel primer coverage rate
Wood ceiling panel finish coat coverage rate

cross_spec_coordination.notes: No cross-spec flags. Wood ceiling work pairs with SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT for adjacent crown molding at ceiling-wall junction. Pairs with SF_WOOD_WALL_NC for wood-paneled rooms where ceiling and wall share finish group. Pairs with SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_NC_FINISH for transition areas where wood ceiling meets drywall ceiling.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup > prep > prime > apply > interstage > finish > cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: TSK_ prefix from resolution.json MUST be used in sop_modules and production
RULE 10: ITM_ IDs marked existing in resolution.json MUST use exact registered ID in spec.json
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values in resolution.json applicable_enums
